newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BIG CANE CROP BOOSTS ILLOVO, OUTLOOK GOOD.
newsitem.headline: BIG CANE CROP BOOSTS ILLOVO, OUTLOOK GOOD.

text.p: South African sugar producer Illovo Sugar Ltd said on Tuesday a good cane crop had boosted headline earnings by 41 percent to 128.5 million rand in the year to September 30, and the company was upbeat about the future.
"The early outlook for the year to September 30, 1997, is promising," the company said in a statement with results.

"The current forecast for the first half of the financial year shows increased earnings of around 20 percent and given favourable weather conditions in the coming summer months, a similar rate of improvement is anticipated for the full year."

Illovo, which accounts for just under 50 percent of South African production, said the completed relocation of its Eston mill would encourage a substantial increase in sugar cane from the area while the Pongola mill was performing well following expansion.
